steps.title: Assign Leadership Roles
steps.guidance:
Confirm who holds each of the 8 leadership roles. Mark roles invested by a PC, and note vacancies (each vacancy adds Unrest at the Adjust Unrest step). The kingdom gains 1 Fame or Infamy point this step - record it in the log.
House rule: status bonuses from kingdom feats stack with status bonuses from invested leadership roles.

steps.title: Adjust Unrest
steps.guidance:
Add Unrest from vacancies, overcrowding, secondary territories and war. Check the kingdom's Unrest thresholds and the Ruin thresholds, and note any effects.
House rule: +1 Unrest if the kingdom's secondary territories include an unconnected settlement (freehold rule).

steps.title: Resource Collection
steps.guidance: Roll the kingdom's resource dice and enter the RP gained. Collect commodities produced by work sites, respecting storage capacity.

checklist.label: Roll Resource Dice, enter RP gained

steps.title: Pay Consumption
steps.guidance: The kingdom's consumption is a typed value on the kingdom sheet. Pay it in Food; if food is short, record the shortfall and the resulting Unrest.

checklist.label: Record any shortfall and resulting Unrest

steps.title: Collect Taxes
steps.guidance:
Log the Collect Taxes Trade check.
House rule: the Bank gives a +1 item bonus to Collect Taxes.

steps.title: Approve Expenses
steps.guidance: Improve Lifestyle or Tap Treasury, if chosen.

checklist.label: Improve Lifestyle or Tap Treasury, if chosen

steps.title: Manage Trade Agreements
steps.guidance: Log a check per trade agreement. Town Hall/Castle/Palace item bonuses apply (see the structure catalog).

steps.title: Leadership Activities
steps.guidance:
Each leader acts up to their activities-per-turn count (typed on the Leader card).
House rules: Take Charge - the same skill cannot be used twice per turn; Request Foreign Aid - once per group per turn, use the faction's current Foreign Aid DC.

steps.title: Region Activities
steps.guidance:
Region activities: Claim Hex, Build Roads, Establish Work Site, Reconnoiter Hex, etc.
House rules: Reconnoiter Hex is a new activity (costs 1 RP, marks the hex reconnoitered); from kingdom level 9 the kingdom can Claim Hex 3 times per turn; see the hex-claim XP table in Reference.

steps.title: Civic Activities
steps.guidance:
One civic activity per settlement; tick the settlement's civic flag when it is used (flags reset when the turn completes).
House rule: checks for an unconnected settlement take a -4 circumstance penalty.

steps.title: Army Activities
steps.guidance: Log army actions when at war.

checklist.label: Log army actions when at war

steps.title: Check for Event
steps.guidance: Make the flat check against the kingdom's event DC (typed on the kingdom sheet) and record the result.

checklist.label: Enter the flat-check DC and roll

steps.title: Resolve Events
steps.guidance: Open or update kingdom events and log their checks. Event XP is awarded by event level (CRB Table 10-2, p. 489).

steps.title: Apply Kingdom XP
steps.guidance: Enter XP gained from milestones, hex claims, events and leftover RP. See the house-rule RP-to-XP and hex-claim XP tables in Reference.

checklist.label: Enter XP from milestones, hexes, events, leftover RP

steps.title: Increase Kingdom Level
steps.guidance:
If the kingdom levels up, record the new level, Control DC, skill increase, feat and boosts (see the advancement table in Reference).
House rules: a skill increase every level from 2; three ability boosts at levels 5/10/15/20; Untrained Improvisation at 2 (full level at 7).

steps.title: End of Turn
steps.guidance: Review modifiers expiring this turn and untick them. Reset per-turn flags. Confirm final RP and commodities, then complete the turn.
